about: tools/manage.py's config on the bots' host (backend local-docker), deployed as /opt/automata/manager.json with the manager at /opt/automata/tools/manage.py and resident.sh and its accounts file in /opt/automata/residents. Paths are relative to this file. A dashboard on another machine uses one with backend ssh instead: see docs/adding-to-your-world.md, Managing them from a dashboard.
